name: Shotgun bearer imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, lugging a short heavy blunderbuss shotgun with a dark slag-iron barrel and a wooden stock, far too big for it

poses.stand: hovering on straining bat wings, the heavy blunderbuss held across its body in both claws
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: heaves the blunderbuss up, fires it forward to the right with a big flash, and is knocked backward by the recoil

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
